title: Village d'été
publicSummary: A summer seafront village with casual food, drinks and family activities on Esplanade Elisée Reclus, useful for guests looking for an easy evening stop in central Menton.
editorialNote: Good low-friction option for families already walking along the seafront; check the official listing for current hours.

title: Visite Guidée du Domaine Gannac en anglais
publicSummary: An English-language guided visit at Maison Gannac with citrus-grove context and a tasting, especially useful for visitors who want a local Menton lemon experience without needing French.
editorialNote: Strong Menton-specific experience for guests interested in local produce; booking and access should be checked before travel.
priceText: Adult ticket listed at 25 EUR on the official source

title: Visites guidées nocturnes : jardin de la Villa Maria Serena
publicTitle: Villa Maria Serena night garden visits
publicSummary: Evening guided visits of Jardin Maria Serena, giving guests a cooler summer way to see one of Menton's most atmospheric gardens after the heat drops.
editorialNote: Useful for warm summer evenings and Garavan-area stays; confirm exact visit slots and booking with the official source.
priceText: Full-price ticket listed at 10 EUR on the official source

title: Visite guidée & atelier parfum Fragonard
publicTitle: Fragonard perfume workshop at Serre de la Madone
publicSummary: A guided garden visit paired with a Fragonard perfume workshop at Serre de la Madone, suited to guests who want a more distinctive booked activity in Menton.
editorialNote: Good premium summer activity; keep booking and accessibility claims tied to the official listing.
priceText: Full-price ticket listed at 30 EUR on the official source

title: Bibliothèque à la plage
publicSummary: A seasonal beach library on Esplanade Francis Palmero with books for adults and children, useful for relaxed beach days and family downtime.
editorialNote: Practical free summer stop near the seafront; verify opening days on the official page.

title: Les visites surprises de Menton
publicSummary: A theatrical guided visit starting by Saint-Michel, designed as a different way to discover Menton's old town and heritage during the summer.
editorialNote: Useful for guests who want a structured old-town walk rather than a self-guided route.
priceText: Full-price ticket listed at 14 EUR on the official source

title: Miss Rainette et le mystère de la statue
publicSummary: A self-guided family mystery trail at Serre de la Madone, built for children and adults to explore the garden through clues, statues and small challenges.
editorialNote: Good family activity when guests want something more structured than another beach session.
priceText: Included with garden visit according to the official source

title: Grande roue de Menton
publicSummary: A summer Ferris wheel at Espace Rondelli, easy to combine with Sablettes, the old town and an evening walk along Menton's seafront.
editorialNote: Simple visual summer attraction for families and evening walks; check official hours before going.
priceText: Full-price ticket listed at 8 EUR on the official source

title: Le train touristique de Menton
publicSummary: A 45-minute narrated tourist train route from Esplanade Francis Palmero through the old town, seafront and higher viewpoints, useful for a low-effort overview of Menton.
editorialNote: Good first-day orientation tool, especially for guests travelling with children or limited walking energy.
priceText: Full-price ticket listed at 12 EUR on the official source
